title: Romancecar to Hakone · Gora gyoza · Open-Air Museum · castle-villa Italian dinner and onsen

stamp.reading: shiro · castle (dinner in the castle-style villa)

stops.name: Check out of Ninja House
stops.plan: Pack overnight bags only (suitcases went to Osaka yesterday), keys back, out by 09:25
stops.transport: Walk to Higashi-Nagasaki, Seibu Ikebukuro line → Ikebukuro, JR Yamanote line → Shinjuku, walk to the Odakyu west concourse, about 46 min

stops.name: Odakyu Sightseeing Service Center: Hakone Freepass
stops.plan: Collect 8 Freepasses (2-day, from Shinjuku) and the Romancecar seats; grab ekiben and coffee for the train
stops.transport: Walk to the Odakyu Romancecar platforms, 3 min

stops.name: Romancecar Shinjuku → Hakone-Yumoto
stops.plan: Booked seats together; ekiben breakfast on board
stops.transport: Hakone Tozan Railway switchback climb Hakone-Yumoto → Chokoku-no-Mori (the 12:39, Freepass), walk 5 min, about 69 min

stops.name: Gyoza Center
stops.plan: Names on the board at the door, then plates of gyoza and a beer for 8
stops.transport: Walk to the Open-Air Museum, 7 min

stops.name: Hakone Open-Air Museum
stops.plan: Giant sculptures on the hillside, the stained-glass tower and the footbath; show the Freepass for the discount
stops.transport: Hakone Tozan bus Chokoku-no-Mori → Sengoku (Freepass), about 30 min with the wait

stops.name: A-Coop Sengokuhara
stops.plan: Beer, sake, chuhai and tomorrow's breakfast for the villa night (closes 18:00)
stops.transport: Taxi to the villa (2 cars), 7 min

stops.name: Check in Hot Spring Hakone Villa
stops.plan: Lockbox self check-in, drinks in the fridge, change for dinner
stops.transport: Taxi to Albergo Bamboo (2 cars), 6 min

stops.name: Albergo Bamboo
stops.plan: Italian dinner in the castle-style villa's upstairs private room for 8: uni and lemon cream pasta, winter game, prosecco
stops.price: Dinner course, price on booking (lunch courses ¥5,000–8,000 pp)
stops.transport: Taxi back to the villa (2 cars), 6 min

stops.name: Villa private onsen and piano night
stops.plan: The villa's own hot spring, drinks from A-Coop, piano singalong; early-ish night for the first ropeway
